actionable_steps.citation: Love And Respect Your Parents And Sanctify Your Life — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 36 (2003), 2003-05-06
actionable_steps.step: If you still can, begin the day by touching your mother's feet and offering your salutations — such a noble practice will protect you always.

actionable_steps.citation: Ideal Parents Have Ideal Children — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 41 (2008), 2008-07-21
actionable_steps.step: Visit your parents regularly, serve them yourself, make them happy, and see to it that they do not suffer in any way.

actionable_steps.citation: Ideal Parents Have Ideal Children — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 41 (2008), 2008-07-21
actionable_steps.step: If you are a parent: put human values into practice in your own life first, then guide your children by your own example — and never burden them with family problems.

actionable_steps.citation: Ideal Parents Have Ideal Children — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 41 (2008), 2008-07-21
actionable_steps.step: Remember that whatever progress you have made is due to your parents' sacrifice — show them gratitude and never cause them even a little trouble.

actionable_steps.citation: Be a care taker — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4 (1964), 1964-08-19
actionable_steps.step: Nourish your aged parents and revere them — honouring them invites the protection of the Mother and Father of the universe.

definition.citation: Bliss Is Your Real Form — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-01
definition.quote: They are the very forms of God. Revere your mother and father as God (Matru Devo bhava, pitru Devo bhava).

discourses.citation: Serve parents, serve God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31 (1998), 1998-11-19
discourses.quote: There is no service greater than service to parents. Consider service to parents as service to the Lord.

discourses.citation: Be a care taker — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4 (1964), 1964-08-19
discourses.quote: Nourish your aged parents; revere them. If you honour your mother, the mother of the Universe will guard you against harm. If you honour your father, the Father of all beings will guard you.

discourses.citation: Ideal Parents Have Ideal Children — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 41 (2008), 2008-07-21
discourses.quote: Giving happiness to parents is the main duty of the children. … Look after the needs of your parents carefully.

discourses.citation: Love And Respect Your Parents And Sanctify Your Life — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 36 (2003), 2003-05-06
discourses.quote: There may be a son in this world who does not love his mother, but there cannot be a mother who does not love her son. … It is your foremost duty to love your mother.

make_it_real: You didn't choose your parents — God did. Call them today, not when you need something.
title: Parents

vahinis.quote: Remain in Ayodhya and comfort mother and father, serving them in suitable ways to remove the sorrow from their hearts. With love and care, confer comfort, courage, and contentment on them.
